name: cannibal.r_caol_first_smoke_011_r020_repaired_roof_distance7_combined_control
description: R011 fresh roof fire smoke/light control on original OMT distance-7 geometry; no camp relocation.

steps.label: load_clean_closed_window_pre_signal_checkpoint
steps.expected_visible_fact: Load only the disposable profile whose 45 TestSetup00 save files match build_logs/first-smoke-011/ordinary-closed-smoke-start-manifest.json. Verify effective userdir, same-run World/current turn, Safe mode Off, no clairvoyance/cloak/invulnerability, no pending input, unlit brazier and no prior site knowledge/signal/outing; saved baseline turn 5216234.

steps.label: no_fixture_transforms
steps.expected_visible_fact: No additional fixture transform is declared; camp geometry is the already-recorded controlled setup in the byte-exact manifest.

steps.label: ordinary_roof_distance7_control_then_combined_channels
steps.objective: From a separate exact clean copy, take the ordinary ladder route to the existing roof brazier and ignite it once with the lighter. Record actual weather and both physical channels, then measure smoke and light packet caps and normal camp LOS/range against the original camp at distance 7. Preserve this as the original geometry control. If either channel is out of range, stop unchanged waits; do not claim combined admission. Continue same-ID camp actors only for any channel actually admitted. Do not relocate the camp in this control; any later controlled geometry arm gets its own named scenario, save delta and eligibility/LOS proof.
proof_targets: 45/45 byte-exact clean start save, effective userdir, same-run World/turn, immutable executable/path receipt, Safe Off and mutations absent
original roof anchor [3156,3447,1]/OMT[131,143,1], original camp [135,137,0], distance7; no camp relocation
ordinary native ladder/level transition and lighter ignition; actual fd_fire before channel sampling
actual weather at sampled intervals and independent physical smoke/light packets with source, exposure and native intensity
channel-specific cap, weather, vertical path and LOS, range, destination see_cost, reason and native admission; smoke reach is separate from combined admission
same-ID scouting/watch/return/report/raid/combat only if native actor admission occurred
quicksaves and saved turns at ignition, packet, admission/divergence and actor transitions; simulation performance and process cleanup
invariants: No signal/contact/report/dispatch/fire/light injection, hostile teleport, clairvoyance, cloak, invulnerability or debug raider kill
Keep the combined light-plus-smoke arm separate from the ordinary closed-room smoke-only arm
Controlled camp-site geometry is setup only, not natural generation or initial knowledge
Use only the ordinary route and advertised action targets; verify each menu result and never batch unobserved movement
Track all relevant actors by metadata and saved roster, including outside player sight; phase labels alone do not establish an assault
Maintain roof brazier fire through observation unless a concrete safety blocker requires stopping
Keep distance-7 roof control unchanged; do not stage camp or change light policy in this scenario.
Do not assume cross-z smoke LOS repair resolves cap6 vs distance7 or light cap4 vs endpoint see_cost5.
If smoke admits but light does not, report smoke admission separately; combined-channel admission remains unproved.
A later controlled camp placement requires another scenario/profile, ordinary eligible camp terrain and measured viable cap/LOS; never overwrite this control.

evidence_contract.claim: Fresh ordinary roof fire emits physical smoke and light, while its original distance-7 camp response is measured independently per channel under actual weather/LOS/caps.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Emission does not prove packet admission; smoke admission does not prove light admission or combined response. Preserve the original geometry and stop at a measured out-of-range gate.
